subject: Acme Robotics - data deletion request vs billing records
messages:
From: Julia Morris <julia.morris@acme-robotics.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-10T09:12:00Z
Subject: Request to delete personal data (including any PII in usage logs) — invoices question

Hi Jonas,

We need to submit a formal data deletion request on behalf of Acme Robotics. Our legal team wants all personal identifiers removed from your systems for user accounts tied to Acme employees (email addresses, names, IPs) — this would include usage logs that list token-level traces. At the same time, finance is asking whether invoice PDFs or billing ledger entries that list charges for our account can be retained for accounting purposes.

Can you confirm:
- What types of records Redwood must keep for statutory accounting in the EU?
- Whether invoices (PDFs) and summarized billing ledger entries are considered "personal data" that need to be deleted?
- If invoices must be retained, whether we can get a copy/export and whether any PII can be redacted/pseudonymized?

Acme prefers deletion where possible, but we understand there may be legal exceptions. Please advise the options and steps and an estimated timeline.

Thanks,
Julia Morris
Head of IT & Security
Acme Robotics

Attachment: acme-deletion-request-20260601.eml (email request stub)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-10T11:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Request to delete personal data (including any PII in usage logs) — invoices question

Hi Julia — thanks for the clear request and the attachment. Looping in Finance (Monica) and Legal (Karthik) to confirm obligations and options.

Preliminary notes from my side:
- We treat invoice PDFs and our billing ledger as transactional/financial records. In many jurisdictions invoices are retained for tax/audit reasons and considered an accounting record (not actioned by default on consumer deletion requests).
- Usage logs (token-level traces, request metadata) often contain PII and are generally in-scope for deletion. We can delete or pseudonymize these on request, subject to any active legal holds.

Monica/Karthik — can you confirm Redwood's retention baseline for EU customers and whether we can provide a redacted invoice export that satisfies Acme's accountants while removing employee emails/names from any attached usage reports?

Jonas
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-11T08:55:00Z
Subject: RE: Request to delete personal data (including any PII in usage logs) — invoices question

Jonas / Karthik,

Finance view (summary):
- Invoice PDFs: retained as accounting records for a rolling 7-year period for EU customers per our policy and local tax requirements. They are generated from the billing ledger and stored in a WORM-like archive.
- Billing ledger: ledger entries (customer, invoice id, amount, tax) are retained for 7 years. Ledger entries by design include minimal PII — typically account name, billing address, VAT id. We do NOT store raw user emails on invoice lines.
- Usage logs / request traces: retained for 90 days by default, then purged, unless the customer opts into longer retention. They can be deleted on request (subject to legal hold).

Options for Acme:
1) Full deletion request for account-level PII in usage logs: we can identify and delete token-level traces and any indexed email references. This will not delete already-exported invoice PDFs from our finance archive (legal exception).
2) Provide redacted invoice export: we can generate copies of historic invoice PDFs and optionally redact contact names/email addresses that appear in attached notes. For accounting purposes, we recommend keeping invoice numbers, amounts, tax lines intact.
3) Pseudonymize ledger: store ledger records with a hashed customer identifier (retained for audit) and store mapping in secure KMS-protected key vault. Mapping can be removed only under CFO/legal approval.

Actions I propose:
- Produce a redacted invoice package for Acme (sample for 2026-05-30 Invoice 7891) and an export of aggregated billing ledger entries.
- Run a deletion job for usage logs for dates provided by Acme after we obtain a signed deletion request.
- If Acme needs ledger entries anonymized instead of deleted, we can discuss pseudonymization and legal approval path.

Attachments: 2026-05-30_Invoice_7891.pdf (pdf), redaction-proposal-20260612.xlsx (proposal with redaction examples).

Monica Patel
Director, Finance Operations
monica_patel@redwood.ai

---Quoted internal note---
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Sent: 2026-06-11T09:12:00Z
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>; Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Subject: Re: data deletion vs invoices

Legal note (quick): EU GDPR permits retention of personal data if necessary for compliance with a legal obligation (tax, accounting). Invoices and ledger entries are a legitimate basis. We should:
- Treat invoices as a legal exception to erasure, document the rationale in the ticket, and provide redacted alternatives where possible.
- Ensure any pseudonymization still allows Redwood to satisfy audits while minimizing access to raw PII.

Karthik
Sr. Counsel, Privacy & Compliance
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Julia Morris <julia.morris@acme-robotics.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-12T15:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Request to delete personal data (including any PII in usage logs) — invoices question

Hi Julia — thanks for your patience. Summary and proposed next steps below: 

What we will do:
- We will honor deletion of account-level PII contained in usage logs and token traces (we'll purge logs older than the date range you confirm).
- We cannot delete invoice PDFs or core billing ledger entries that are required for statutory accounting; these are retained for 7 years per our policy and are a legal exception.
- We will produce a redacted invoice package for the invoices you specify (we can remove contact names/emails from attached notes). The invoice numbers, dates, line items, amounts and VAT lines will remain unchanged to preserve accounting integrity.
- We can offer a pseudonymized ledger export (hashed account id) as an additional privacy measure if Acme wants ledger records without a direct mapping to individual employees. This requires CFO sign-off and a short approval process.

What we need from Acme:
- Confirm which invoices (date range or invoice IDs) you want included in the redacted package.
- Sign the attached deletion request authorization (we've attached an export stub back to you).

Timeline:
- Redacted invoice package: 3 business days after confirmation of invoice list.
- Deletion job for usage logs: 5 business days after signed request and confirmation of date ranges.
- Pseudonymization of ledger: depends on CFO/legal sign-off (estimate ~2 weeks).

If that works, we'll kick off the redaction run for the May invoice as a sample and share results.

Best,
Jonas
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
